- **Laravel Development** — Custom web apps, REST APIs, admin panels, payment integrations, queue processing
- **Flutter App Development** — Cross-platform Android & iOS apps from a single Dart codebase
- **API Design & Development** — Scalable, well-documented RESTful APIs with authentication and rate limiting
- **DevOps & Cloud** — CI/CD pipelines, Docker containerization, cloud deployment, server management
- **System Architecture** — Tech stack selection, database design, cloud infrastructure, scalability planning
- **Full-Stack Development** — End-to-end web apps from database to polished frontend
- **IT Consulting** — Code audits, architecture reviews, performance optimization, team mentoring
